page.title: Antenna Statistics
page.description: Each receive chain of the LTE primary cell and of the 5G cell: which ones the modem uses, their live RSRP and SINR, and how they spread over the last minutes. Which connector feeds which chain depends on the band.

statistics.qmi_footnote: QMI reports the per-chain RSRP only: the per-chain SINR needs diag_bridge.
statistics.no_nr_chain_snr: No per-chain SNR reported: not every firmware logs it. The cell SINR comes from QMI or the last RRC measurement report.

no_cell.hint_lte: Chains appear while the modem is attached to an LTE cell.
no_cell.hint_nr: Chains appear while the modem uses a 5G NR cell (NSA or SA).

stats.description_one: {{metric}} of each chain over the window, {{count}} sample: the bar spans the 10th to 90th percentile, the tick marks the median.
stats.description_other: {{metric}} of each chain over the window, {{count}} samples: the bar spans the 10th to 90th percentile, the tick marks the median.
stats.empty: No per-chain {{metric}} samples in this window.
stats.empty_hint_nr: Not every firmware logs the per-chain SNR.
stats.empty_hint_lte: Per-chain SINR comes from DIAG only.
stats.footnote: Values in {{unit}}. vs Main is the mean gap to the Main chain over the samples where both report; Seen is the share of the window's samples in which the chain reported.

page.title: Antenna Alignment
page.description: Record antenna angles or positions and compare them: each recording averages five seconds of the serving cells' RSRP and SINR, and the best one is recommended. The cards below show what each receive chain sees live.

alignment.no_serving_cell_alert: The modem reports no serving cell right now. Recording waits until it has one.
alignment.no_data_alert: No live radio data: the bridges are not connected. Recording waits until data comes back.

meter.title: Alignment Meter
meter.description_directional: Record three angles to find the best aim. Each recording averages {{samples}} one-second samples of the serving cells.
meter.description_omni: Record three positions to find the best placement. Each recording averages {{samples}} one-second samples of the serving cells.

recommendation.label: Recommended:
recommendation.highest_angle_ahead_one: This angle scored highest, {{count}} point ahead of {{label}}.
recommendation.highest_angle_ahead_other: This angle scored highest, {{count}} points ahead of {{label}}.
recommendation.highest_position_ahead_one: This position scored highest, {{count}} point ahead of {{label}}.
recommendation.highest_position_ahead_other: This position scored highest, {{count}} points ahead of {{label}}.
recommendation.within_noise: The gap is within normal signal fluctuation: record again to confirm.
recommendation.mixed_cells: The slots were recorded on different serving cells, so part of the difference comes from the cell, not the antenna.
recommendation.remaining_one: Record the remaining {{count}} slot for a fuller comparison.
recommendation.remaining_other: Record the remaining {{count}} slots for a fuller comparison.

hint.no_common: The recorded slots share no measurement to compare.
hint.record_two_angle: Record at least two angles to get a recommendation.
hint.record_two_position: Record at least two positions to get a recommendation.

footer.score: Score 0 to 100: 60% RSRP (−140 to −44 dBm) and 40% SINR (−20 to 30 dB), averaged over what every recorded slot measured. Chains lists the RSRP of Main, Diversity, MIMO 3 and MIMO 4.
footer.score_basis: Score 0 to 100: 60% RSRP (−140 to −44 dBm) and 40% SINR (−20 to 30 dB), averaged over what every recorded slot measured (now: {{basis}}). Chains lists the RSRP of Main, Diversity, MIMO 3 and MIMO 4.
